review_output: {"summary":"The release-path fix holds: deleting an admission keeps history. One MAJOR remains: revoking or editing a single form submission still invalidates every report for the whole version. Two MINORs: shortening an admission's expiry runs an unscoped report update that can't use the index, and invalidation silently misses reports under REPEATABLE READ.","findings":[{"area":"Invalidation scope","severity":"MAJOR","file":"migration.sql: wp20_metric_source_changed (FormSubmission branch)","issue":"Changing one submission adds 1 to the version's sourceRevision, so every report for that version goes stale. This is the same problem as the old release bug, now on revocation.","evidence":"The FormSubmission branch runs UPDATE LiveMetricVersion SET sourceRevision+1, and wp20_metric_report_invalidate then marks every report with an older inputRevision as stale, whatever its time window.","impact":"Revoking one viewer stales all completed reports and briefly holds up ingestion for that version behind an exclusive version lock.","recommended_fix":"Only mark stale the reports whose windows overlap that registration's verifiedAt and its sessions' anchorAt to expiresAt ranges. Lock the version FOR SHARE and leave sourceRevision alone.","required_test":"Create 500 viewers with ready reports in separate windows, revoke one submission, and check that only overlapping windows go stale and sourceRevision does not change.","confidence":0.65},{"area":"Index use / lock scope","severity":"MINOR","file":"migration.sql: wp20_metric_source_changed (admission branch)","issue":"When an admission's expiry is shortened, the report UPDATE and the version lock filter only on versionId. Every report index starts with vendorId, so the query scans the table.","evidence":"WHERE \"versionId\"=version_id AND window... has no vendorId or liveId. The 500-release test only ran the DELETE path, which returns early.","impact":"Each shortened expiry scans the whole LiveMetricReport table while holding the LiveViewerSession row lock.","recommended_fix":"SELECT DISTINCT vendorId, liveId, versionId from the sessions and filter both the lock and the UPDATE on all three columns.","required_test":"With 100k reports, run EXPLAIN on the shortened-expiry path and check it uses LiveMetricReport_scope_window_revision_key, not a sequential scan.","confidence":0.75},{"area":"Isolation","severity":"MINOR","file":"migration.sql: wp20_metric_evidence_changed","issue":"Invalidation only works under READ COMMITTED. Under REPEATABLE READ, the trigger's snapshot can't see a report created and claimed after it, so that report is never marked stale.","evidence":"Sequence: E (RR) starts, R creates and commits, worker claims and reads, E inserts and commits, worker finishes and gets ready with E's evidence missing.","impact":"A report can be marked ready with stale results if any writer uses Prisma's isolationLevel RepeatableRead or Serializable.","recommended_fix":"In the evidence and guard triggers, raise an error unless current_setting('transaction_isolation') is 'read committed', or document and enforce that requirement.","required_test":"Run that sequence with two transactions, the writer under REPEATABLE READ, and assert the finish call is rejected or the report goes stale.","confidence":0.5}]}
